header.title: Divider
header.description: Horizontal or vertical rule to separate content. Pass `children` for a labeled separator. `tone` changes the color. Without a label it is purely visual; with a label it is announced as `role="separator"`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to preview the divider and its code. When vertical, the divider stretches to the height of its flex container.
playground.label: or continue with

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: With no props, it draws a 1px horizontal rule in the border color that spans the available width.

texts.heading: Section heading
texts.body: Body copy sits on either side of the rule to show how it separates blocks of content.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: `orientation="vertical"` draws a rule that stretches with `align-self: stretch`. Put it inside a flex container with a height; otherwise it falls back to a `1.5rem` minimum.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` fills the line and the label: `default` uses the border color; the rest use the tone color. The example uses `size="md"` so the color stands out.

label.title: With label
label.description: `children` sit on the rule. `labelPlacement` puts them at the `start`, `center` (default) or `end`. With a label, the divider gets `role="separator"`.

verticalLabel.title: Vertical label
verticalLabel.description: Labels work vertically too: the line splits above and below the text. It needs at least `6rem` of height.

inContent.title: In content
inContent.description: Separate list entries or mark a date change with a label. In a toolbar, a vertical divider groups actions.

texts.first: Shipping updates land in this feed as soon as a parcel leaves the warehouse.
texts.second: Delivery windows are estimates. Open the tracking page for the latest scan.
texts.third: A courier attempted delivery at 14:20. The parcel is held at the local depot.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: `decorative` forces the behavior: with `false` and no label, the divider is announced as a separator, so give it an `aria-label`. With `true` and a label, it is hidden from screen readers.

header.title: Divider API
header.description: API reference for the React Divider component: props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Divider accepts <div> attributes except children, which is replaced by the label. They go to the root along with ref. role, aria-orientation and aria-hidden override the values the component computes.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.decorative: Without a label, the divider is decorative: it has role="none" and aria-hidden, so screen readers skip it.
a11y.label: With a label it has role="separator" and the label is its accessible name. The lines on each side have aria-hidden.
a11y.semantic: If the separation matters and there is no label, pass decorative={false} and an aria-label.
a11y.override: Pass role, aria-orientation or aria-hidden to override the automatic values.
a11y.contrast: The label uses the tone color. With warning, success or tertiary on a light background, contrast may fall below 4.5:1.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root. Defines the variables and paints the line when there is no label. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.withLabel: Applied when there are `children`. The root becomes flex with two lines and the label.
rules.line: Each line segment next to the label. Receives `classNames.line`.
rules.label: Label. Receives `classNames.label`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Divider's own variables. The size and tone classes set them, so use `.gem-divider.your-class` to override them.

items.--gem-divider-color: Color of the line and of a toned label.
items.--gem-divider-gap: Space between the label and the lines.

items.--gem-color-{success|warning|error|info}: Color of the status tones. `danger` uses `error`.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.tone: Color of the line and the label.
items.children: Label on the rule. With a label, the divider is no longer decorative.
items.decorative: Hides the divider from screen readers. Defaults to `true` without a label and `false` with one.
items.role: Root role. Defaults to `none` when decorative and `separator` otherwise.
